papers.title: Aligning LLMs with Human Uncertainty: A Beta-Bernoulli Calibrator for LLM Forecasting
papers.what: A post-hoc, model-agnostic calibrator turns any LLM point forecast into a Beta distribution, giving a better-calibrated mean and an epistemic variance that predicts error better than verbalized confidence.
papers.builds_on: TS-Agent (Liu 2025), LLMs for Time Series Survey (Zhang 2024)

papers.title: Diffusion Large Language Models for Visual Speech Recognition
papers.what: First diffusion-LLM lip-reading framework: transcribes by confidence-ordered masked denoising with bidirectional context and length-guided decoding, reaching 19.5% WER on LRS3.

papers.title: Mamoda2.5: Enhancing a Unified Multimodal Model with DiT-MoE
papers.what: Makes a Diffusion Transformer backbone sparse with a 128-expert top-8 MoE (25B params, 3B active), setting a video-editing record and cutting editing inference up to 95.9x via few-step distillation plus RL.

papers.title: MicroWorld: Bridging the Microscopic Domain Gap for Multimodal LLMs
papers.what: Builds a multimodal attributed property graph from scientific image-caption corpora to ground a multimodal LLM in microscopy concepts, closing part of the domain gap that contrastive pretraining leaves open.
